Welcome to my homepage.

I am a research assistant at the Mathematics Institute of the Universität zu Köln since September 2026. I work under the supervision of Prof. George Marinescu and Prof. Alexander Drewitz in the framework of the DFG funded project Random Polynomials and Random Kähler Geometry.

I received my PhD from Université Paris Cité in May 2026, where I conducted my research at IMJ-PRG. My thesis was about Berezin–Toeplitz quantization, and was supervised by Prof. Xiaonan Ma and Prof. George Marinescu.
